title: Draft candidate κ = 0.001343523016252057: stage-specific complex gauge; verification pending
body:
Draft candidate: **computed conditional κ = 0.001343523016252057**, about **0.0003720184% above #501/#502**. **Full physical verification is pending; this is not yet an admitted new bound.**

The new `research/complex-stage4-gauge-mix/` package uses #501's retimed gauge/kernel word everywhere except the middle stage. At that stage, helper 540's entrance drops from rank 4 to rank 2. All eight middle-stage invocations use the changed word; the remaining 64 retain the baseline. Unlike applying this change globally, the stage-dependent allocation fits every whole helper on existing data families with no banks.

Completed: both exact moment engines, adjacent-root rejection, 47 strict outer arithmetic margins and four negative controls; explicit slot coloring for all 40,320 helper roles with one helper per physical family per invocation. Complex endpoint: `1345330498741582613827/1000000000000000000000000`. The profile and serialized words/assignments are included.

Still required: changed local Gaussian/common-label and full program replay, independent physical chart/controller checks, mixed global prefix and finite coefficient invoice. Arithmetic assumes inherited row allowance 20161 and bit coefficient 6464 until those checks justify them. All inherited all-size compiler, mutable-basis, Lemma A spectator realization, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer conditions remain. This does not use the disputed split-residual interface.

Published as an early draft before full verification, as requested. No full replay or CI pass is claimed for the new package. Historical R715 packages and receipts below remain unchanged.

---

Conditional kappa **0.001297486611380425**, exactly `51899464455217/40000000000000000`: **0.06745494% above our previous0.001296611982495107**. The bit supplier binds. This compares the complete whole-family contract; it does not exceed PR480's larger disputed cross-family headline.

The new `research/r715-basis-exchange84/` package exchanges pivot and donor roles in the response kernel, updates every affected response equation, and promotes entrances while preserving nested donor chains. It keeps110 pivots but raises total entrance rank129→139, with102 distinct donors,130 correction rows and19 coordinate residual isometries. It retains PR483's14 target factors and22 paired source-injection cancellations. Exact rational packing scales the assignment to84 replicas: all660660 helper occurrences stay whole on individual physical families across924 complete invocations.

At draft submission, fresh source reconstruction and all955 arbitrary-dirty columns,110 correction-omission controls,22 single-injection controls,native signed/formal checks,labels/mixing/Gram checks,physical emission and independent ownership audit,fresh invoice,both rational moments and47outer inequalities passed. Initial assembly explicitly reused the unchanged completed complex supplier after binding87 implementation hashes and17 output hashes to its completed receipt. **Fresh full Python3.14 passed**, rebuilding both suppliers. **Complete Python3.11 passed** with explicit completed-complex reuse, checking its receipt,87 implementation hashes and17 output hashes. Receipts/logs are in `research/r715-basis-exchange84-validation/`. No GitHub CI pass is claimed.

Bit lower `649586135003318032049/500000000000000000000000`; complex lower `1305231506267591/1000000000000000000`. Run `python -B research/r715-basis-exchange84/verify.py /absolute/new/output`. Default reconstructs both suppliers; explicit `--complex-output` accepts only the pinned completed provider and emits a distinct reuse receipt. Python3.11+,SymPy,C++17 and Boost are required. Python3.11/3.14 CI includes the new package. The verifier reconstructs the final witness directly and runs no optimizer; it does not claim to replay every search decision.

Credits: PR483 (Dugongue) supplies the nested110-pivot seed,response-packet method and target factors, building on our warm PR473 kernel and PR478. PR485's basis-selection work motivated the role-exchange search; its112-pivot seed was tested but is not the winning seed. New basis exchanges,nested promotions,source reconstruction and84-replica rational packing by Rohan Arun with OpenAI Codex assistance. All upstream notices remain intact. Earlier complete28/64/84 packages and their receipts remain unchanged.

All inherited all-size compiler/supplier,correlated-dirty complete-call hosting,same-owner spectator,mutable-label,precision and analytic interfaces remain conditional. This is not an unconditional multiplication theorem or a global optimum. Failed and non-improving searches continue in PR477.

Subsequent frontier note: PR493 now reports a stronger489-helper bit construction and kappa0.001303530097714685 with the same cited complex supplier. This PR does not claim to exceed that newer result; it records the independently replayed R715 improvement and its reusable basis-exchange mechanism.
